prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in earlier (after adoption selection or photo upload) and adding targeted sign-in clarification hints were helpful, but placing sign-in after the adoption certificate severely degraded conversion (-22.4%).
Adding specific interactive or setup-focused new screens (Visibility Check, Interactive Welcome, Sound Calibration, Pet Personality Intro) was helpful, whereas multi-step setup flows (System Tray flow, Sound Verification flow) hurt conversion.
Select layout redesigns (Stage adoption, Story scroll/stage/grid, Checklist intro) won, but redesigning photo upload layouts (Grid, Card, Split Pick Friend) and waiting screen spotlight severely hurt conversion (down to -23.3%).
Most audio cues, progress bars, tip carousels, notification enable toggles, and standalone headline updates showed no clear effect.
Predictions were overly optimistic for non-winning changes, predicting gains up to +12.0% on features that showed no clear effect or caused severe drops.
Predictions were frequently too low or negative (down to -8.0%) for winning features that delivered large positive impacts (up to +14.0%).

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] New Companion Desktop Shortcuts Screen: Add a new desktop controls overview screen before completing onboarding that details keyboard shortcuts and system tray controls. (why: Support received multiple complaints from users who were confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their desktop pet after completing setup.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Carousel Layout Redesign for Choose Path Screen: Redesign the choose path screen using a clean carousel layout to highlight each companion path option individually. (why: Choose path has a median duration of 8s but a mean of 514s, indicating that some users hesitate or get confused by the layout.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Multi Device Account Persistence Hint: Add a clear hint on the sign-in screen informing users that signing in preserves pet identity and save state across sessions. (why: 8 support tickets cited pets disappearing or resetting after re-login; reinforcing account persistence at sign-in addresses this fear.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Graphic Loading Note: Add a desktop graphic loading note on the waiting screen explaining that local desktop rendering engines and pet graphics are initializing. (why: Home waiting time is very high (median 201s / mean 2336s) and 3 users reported pets failing to show on desktop upon initial launch.)
4: [finish, hint] Home Intro Companion Trait Calibration Hint: Add a helpful hint on the home intro screen explaining where to find pet controls and behavior preferences. (why: Multiple support emails expressed confusion on how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding.)
5: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Pick Friend: Move sign-in to take place immediately after picking a pet friend, letting users choose their pet before creating or linking an account. (why: Earlier lessons showed moving sign-in later improved adoption motivation, and placing it right after pet selection leverages emotional attachment.)
6: [adoption, copy] Pick Friend Companion Archetype Headline Clarification: Update the main headline on the pick friend screen to emphasize selecting a companion archetype. (why: The adoption stage drops to 80.1% conversion; framing the pet selection clearly encourages decisive progression.)
7: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Quick Companion Overview Hint: Add an explanatory hint on the choose path screen summarizing the difference between standard preset pets and custom creations. (why: Choose path has a high mean time of 514s, indicating that users pause when choosing between setup options.)
